title: Physics SSC-I Chapters 1 & 2 Past Papers (2014–2024 MCQs)
description: Complete 44 Past Paper Questions covering Physical Quantities & Measurements (Chap 1) and Kinematics (Chap 2) with 100% verified step-by-step solutions.
subject: Physics

questions.stemText: The total number of significant figures in 0.002022 are
questions.explanation: In 0.002022, leading zeros (0.00) are place-holders and not significant. All non-zero digits and zeros between non-zero digits (2, 0, 2, 2) are significant. Hence, there are exactly 4 significant figures.

questions.stemText: The number 0.0000509 can be represented in scientific notation as
questions.explanation: In standard scientific notation, moving the decimal point 5 places to the right gives 5.09 with a negative power of ten: 5.09 \times 10^{-5}.

questions.stemText: If the volume of the given cuboid is 0.03 m³, then the value of x will be (2015)
questions.explanation: Volume = length × width × height = 0.5 m × 0.2 m × x = 0.10x. Given Volume = 0.03 m³, we have 0.10x = 0.03 ⇒ x = 0.03 / 0.10 = 0.3 m.

questions.stemText: The given graph depicts that a person is walking along a straight road. Which of the following options CORRECTLY describes the motion of the person from point X to Y?

options.text: The person is moving towards the starting point at a constant speed.
The person is moving towards the starting point with a variable speed.
The person is moving away from the starting point at a constant speed.
The person is moving away from the starting point with a variable speed.

questions.explanation: From point X to Y on the distance-time graph, the graph is a straight sloping line returning to distance = 0 (the starting point). A straight line indicates a constant gradient (constant speed) directed back to the origin.

questions.stemText: A force of 10 N is acting on a body along x-axis. The value of its y-component will be
questions.explanation: When a vector lies purely along the x-axis, its angle with the x-axis is 0°. The vertical component is Fy = F sin(0°) = 10 N × 0 = 0 N.

questions.stemText: A body starts from rest and accelerates to a velocity of 100 m/s. If it covers a distance of 50 m, then its acceleration will be
questions.explanation: Using the 3rd equation of motion: 2as = vf² - vi². Here vi = 0 m/s, vf = 100 m/s, and s = 50 m. Therefore: 2 × a × 50 = (100)² - 0 ⇒ 100a = 10,000 ⇒ a = 100 m/s².

questions.stemText: The below given picture shows the velocity-time graph for the motion of a body. The slope of the line segment WX in the above graph shows the (2015)

options.text: total distance covered by the body.
total time taken for the motion of the body.

questions.explanation: The slope (gradient) of a velocity-time graph represents the rate of change of velocity, which is acceleration (a = Δv/Δt). The area under the graph represents displacement.

questions.stemText: If a motorcyclist covers a displacement of 150 m in 10 s, then his/ her velocity will be
questions.explanation: Velocity is the displacement covered per unit time: v = s / t = 150 m / 10 s = 15 m/s.

questions.stemText: The number 123.4 can be written in scientific notation as
questions.explanation: In standard scientific notation, one non-zero digit precedes the decimal point. Shifting the decimal point two places to the left gives 1.234 \times 10^2.

questions.stemText: Candela is the S.I. unit of
questions.explanation: In the International System of Units (SI), candela (cd) is the base unit of luminous intensity. (Amount of substance is mole, temperature is kelvin, electric current is ampere).

questions.stemText: The sum of 8.2 \times 10^4 and 4 \times 10^6 in scientific notation is
questions.explanation: Express both numbers with the same power of 10: 8.2 \times 10^4 = 0.082 \times 10^6. Adding them gives: (0.082 + 4.0) \times 10^6 = 4.082 \times 10^6 ≈ 4.08 \times 10^6.

questions.stemText: A 4 kg school bag is being carried by a student. The mass of the bag in grams (g) is equal to
questions.explanation: 1 kg = 1000 g = 10³ g. Therefore, 4 kg = 4 × 10³ g.

questions.stemText: The S.I. unit that represents a vector quantity is
questions.explanation: A (ampere) = electric current (scalar), K (kelvin) = temperature (scalar), m³ = volume (scalar), and m/s² = acceleration, which is a vector quantity having both magnitude and direction.

questions.stemText: If two forces of 3 N and 4 N are perpendicular to each other, then the magnitude of their resultant force will be
questions.explanation: For two perpendicular vectors at 90°, the resultant magnitude is R = √(F₁² + F₂²) = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 N.

questions.stemText: In a mountainous region where land sliding is common, a piece of rock suddenly falls from a certain height and strikes the ground in 3 s. The distance that this piece of rock covers to reach the ground is (Note: The value of acceleration due to gravity is 9.8 m/s².)
questions.explanation: Since the rock falls freely from rest, initial velocity vi = 0 m/s, time t = 3 s, and g = 9.8 m/s². Using h = vit + ½gt²: h = 0 + ½(9.8)(3)² = 4.9 × 9 = 44.1 m.

questions.stemText:
The given table shows the distance covered by a car in four different segments.
Segment I: 0-10 m
Segment II: 11-22 m
Segment III: 23-35 m
Segment IV: 36-49 m
If the car takes same interval of time to cover all four segments, then the car

options.text: comes to rest after each segment.

questions.explanation:
Distance covered in each equal time interval:
Segment I = 10 m
Segment II = 11 m
Segment III = 12 m
Segment IV = 13 m
Since the distance covered in successive equal time intervals is increasing, speed is increasing over time, which means the car is accelerating.

questions.stemText: The physical quantity that is measured in metre per second (m/s) is
questions.explanation: Metre per second (m/s) is the SI derived unit of speed and velocity. (Time is s, distance is m, and acceleration is m/s²).

questions.stemText: The scientific notation of 0.00002019 is
questions.explanation: Moving the decimal point 5 places to the right yields 2.019 \times 10^{-5}.

questions.stemText: The total number of significant figures in 2030 is
questions.explanation: In 2030, without a trailing decimal point, the trailing zero is not significant; only digits 2, 0, and 3 are significant, yielding 3 significant figures.

questions.stemText: The instrument used to measure the length of a solid cylinder is called a
questions.explanation: Vernier callipers are used to accurately measure dimensions of solid cylinders such as length and external diameter up to 0.1 mm precision.

questions.stemText: Which of the following physical quantities is obtained by the formula change in velocity/time interval?
questions.explanation: Acceleration is defined as the time rate of change of velocity: a = Δv / Δt.

questions.stemText: If a tractor starts from rest in a field, reaching its maximum velocity of 5 m/s in 10 s, then the acceleration of the tractor will be
questions.explanation: Given vi = 0 m/s, vf = 5 m/s, and t = 10 s. Acceleration a = (vf - vi) / t = (5 - 0) / 10 = 0.5 m/s².

questions.stemText: A distance-time graph of a moving object is given below. With reference to the given graph, the distance covered during 10 to 12 hrs is
questions.explanation: From t = 10 hrs to t = 12 hrs, the graph is horizontal at distance = 10 km, meaning the object is stationary and the distance covered is 10 km - 10 km = 0 km.

questions.stemText: The value of acceleration due to gravity ‘g’ is considered to be constant (9.8 m/s²) for

options.text: a rocket launched in the air.
an object in free fall motion.
a car moving on a straight road

questions.explanation: Near Earth's surface, freely falling bodies in the absence of air resistance experience a constant acceleration due to gravity g = 9.8 m/s² towards Earth's centre.

questions.stemText: If 1.76 cm³ is the volume of one cube, then the volume of twenty-one such cubes rounded off to three significant figures is
questions.explanation: Total volume = 21 × 1.76 cm³ = 36.96 cm³. Rounding to 3 significant figures: the 4th digit is 6 (≥ 5), which rounds 9 up to 10, giving 37.0 cm³.

questions.stemText: The number 123.4 can also be written in scientific notation as
questions.explanation: Standard scientific notation requires exactly one non-zero digit before the decimal point: 1.234 \times 10^2.

questions.stemText: The prefix used for the multiple value of 10⁻⁹ is
questions.explanation: 10⁻⁹ is represented by the SI prefix 'nano' (n). (atto is 10⁻¹⁸, femto is 10⁻¹⁵, pico is 10⁻¹²).

questions.stemText: All of the following are the scalar quantities EXCEPT
questions.explanation: Time, mass, and distance are scalar quantities described completely by magnitude alone. Velocity has both magnitude and direction, making it a vector quantity.

questions.stemText: The moving blades of an electric fan exemplifies
questions.explanation: Rotatory motion is the spinning motion of a rigid body about a fixed axis passing through it. The blades of an electric fan rotate about its central axis.

questions.stemText:

Segment I: 0-10 m
Segment II: 11-22 m
Segment III: 23-35 m
Segment IV: 36-49 m
If the car takes same interval of time to cover all four segments, then the car

options.text: comes to rest after each segment.

questions.explanation: The distance increments are 10 m, 11 m, 12 m, 13 m in equal time intervals. Since distance covered per unit time is increasing, velocity is increasing, which means the car is accelerating.

questions.stemText: A force of 10 N is acting on a body along x-axis. The value of its y-component will be
questions.explanation: Because the vector lies entirely along the horizontal x-axis, its perpendicular component along the vertical y-axis is Fy = F sin(0°) = 0 N.

questions.stemText: If two forces of 3 N and 4 N are acting at a point, perpendicular to each other, then their resultant force will be
questions.explanation: By vector addition: R = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 N.

questions.stemText: Consider the given speed-time graph. The speed of an object from point X to Y is
questions.explanation: On a speed-time graph, a horizontal straight line parallel to the time axis indicates constant speed over time (uniform speed).

questions.stemText: An athlete runs around a circular track of radius 50 m and finishes at the same point where he began his journey. His total displacement in metre(s) is evaluated to be
questions.explanation: Displacement is the vector connecting the starting position to the final position. Since the athlete returns to the exact starting point, displacement = 0 m.

questions.stemText: A boy starts his travelling from a point P and ends at point S. The magnitude of displacement from point P to S is
questions.explanation: The boy travels P(0,0) → Q(5,0) → R(5,3) → S(0,3). The net displacement from P(0,0) to S(0,3) is the straight-line distance along the y-axis, which is 3 m.

questions.stemText: In 0.020180, the total numbers of significant figures are
questions.explanation: In 0.020180, the leading zeros (0.0) are not significant. Digits 2, 0, 1, 8 and the final trailing zero 0 are all significant, giving a total of 5 significant figures.

questions.stemText: The type of motion that takes place in a simple pendulum is
questions.explanation: The back-and-forth oscillation of the bob of a simple pendulum about its central equilibrium position is classic vibratory (oscillatory) motion.

questions.stemText: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity is a vector quantity possessing both magnitude and spatial direction. Time, mass, and distance are scalar quantities.

questions.stemText: Using head to tail rule of vector addition, which vector diagram, represents the resultant of vectors A and B as vector C?

options.text: Diagram A (Tail of B at head of A, C from tail of A to head of B)
Diagram B (C points left from head of B to tail of A)
Diagram C (Both vectors meet heads at apex)
Diagram D (Vector A reversed away from vertex)

questions.explanation: According to the head-to-tail rule, vector B starts at the head of vector A, and the resultant vector C connects the tail of the first vector A directly to the head of the last vector B.

questions.stemText: The density of pure water is 1000 kg/m³. This value in scientific notation can be written as
questions.explanation: 1000 kg/m³ = 1.0 × 10³ kg/m³ in standard scientific notation with one non-zero digit before the decimal point.

questions.stemText: Which of the following statements is CORRECT about force and velocity?

options.text: Force is a vector quantity and velocity is a scalar quantity.
Force is a scalar quantity and velocity is a vector quantity.

questions.explanation: Force has both magnitude and direction (vector). Velocity has both magnitude and direction (vector). Thus, both are vector quantities.

questions.stemText: Which of the following measuring instruments is used to find the diameter of a metallic wire?
questions.explanation: A micrometer screw gauge has a least count of 0.01 mm, making it the standard instrument to accurately measure the tiny diameter of a metallic wire.

questions.stemText: The gradient of a line on the distance-time graph represents
questions.explanation: The gradient (slope) of a distance-time graph is Δd / Δt, which represents speed.

questions.stemText: In a classroom, a student gets up from his desk and walks 5 metre ahead to his friend’s desk, collects a book and walks 5 metre back to his own desk. The total displacement of the student will be
questions.explanation: Displacement is the vector connecting the starting point to the final point. Because the student returns to his own desk, his final position is identical to his initial position, so net displacement is 0 metre.

questions.stemText: In the given diagram showing part of a Vernier calliper the Vernier scale reading is
questions.explanation: The least count of the Vernier calliper is 0.1 mm. The 6th division of the Vernier scale coincides with a main scale line. Vernier scale reading = 6 × 0.1 mm = 0.6 mm.

questions.stemText: All of the following describe the role of physics in technology EXCEPT
questions.explanation: Internet, electronics, and measuring instruments are technological applications of physics. Vaccines are medical biological interventions developed through immunology and microbiology.

questions.stemText: If a car travels at an average speed of 80 m/s in a race and covers a distance of 640,000 m, then the time taken by the car will be
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed = 640,000 m / 80 m/s = 8,000 s.

questions.stemText: The mass of the empty sugar container in the given figure is
questions.explanation: Total reading on the electronic balance = 1008.9 g. The sugar inside has mass 1 kg = 1000 g. Therefore, empty container mass = 1008.9 g - 1000 g = 8.9 g.

questions.stemText: Which of the following is the CORRECT number of significant figures and the standard form of a radius 0.0340 cm?
questions.explanation: In 0.0340 cm, leading zeros are not significant, but the trailing zero is significant, giving 3 significant figures. In standard scientific form, moving the decimal 2 places to the right gives 3.40 \times 10^{-2} cm.
